chapter: Early bands and New Orleans musicians
title: Born on Magazine Street and musicians in the neighborhood
summary: He was born at 1364 Magazine Street; the Majanas and Woodrow lived near him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were you born in this neighborhood, by the way? In this neighborhood?
No, I was born on Thalian Magazine. That's down. 1364 Magazine Street.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: Since we've been married, that's 40 years.
Well, I've been up here about 40 years.
Were there many musicians in the neighborhood? In this neighborhood? No, in that neighborhood when you were growing up. Did you know many guys right from the...
I knew the Majotas lived right around the corner from me. Woodrow lived right around the corner from me.
Seems like a lot of people came from this neighborhood who played music. Yeah.
